newsitem.title: USA: Blue chip stocks rebound, Nasdaq rises.
newsitem.headline: Blue chip stocks rebound, Nasdaq rises.

text.p: Wall Street stocks traded higher on Tuesday after a lackluster opening.
The Dow industrials gained about 14 points to 7786. Earlier in the day, the Dow slipped more than 50 points in profit taking.
The Nasdaq composite rose about eight points, or 0.56 percent, to 1440.

Analysts said investors absorbed a slew of economic data this morning, all of which fell within estimates, and took some profits from last week's rally before running the Dow to a new high of 7810.08.
